name: Naruto - A genin tale
source: You take control of a boy who, after his village was attacked, is sent to the Hidden Leaf Village to continue his ninja training. You will also have to discover what happened to your family and look for those responsible for attacking your village
translation: 你控制一个男孩，他的村庄遭到袭击后，被送往木叶村继续忍者训练。你还必须查明你的家人发生了什么事，并寻找那些袭击你的村庄的人
